title: "Research Impact | NAU School of Earth and Sustainability"
summary: "World-class research in earth sciences, environmental sustainability, and climate science at NAU. Faculty publications, citations, and research impact metrics."
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
type: landing

sections:
  - block: hero
    content:
      title: "Research Impact"
      text: |
        ## School of Earth and Sustainability
        
        The [School of Earth and Sustainability (SES)](https://nau.edu/school-earth-sustainability/) at [Northern Arizona University](https://nau.edu) conducts world-class research in Earth sciences, environmental sustainability, and climate science. Our faculty and students publish in leading journals, advancing knowledge that addresses the most pressing challenges facing our planet.
      image:
        filename: welcome.jpg
    design:
      background:
        gradient_start: 'rgba(0, 52, 102, 0.7)'
        gradient_end: 'rgba(0, 52, 102, 0.7)'
        text_color_light: true

  - block: markdown
    content:
      text: |
        ```{r faculty-stats, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
        # Load the statistics
        if(file.exists("../../website_stats.rds")) {
          stats <- readRDS("../../website_stats.rds")
        } else {
          # Fallback - generate stats if file doesn't exist
          source("../../R/generate_website_stats.R")
          stats <- readRDS("../../website_stats.rds")
        }
        
        # Convert markdown formatting to HTML
        quote1_html <- gsub("\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", stats$quote1)
        
        cat('<div class="row">
          <div class="col-12">
            <div class="alert alert-info">
              <h4>Faculty Research Impact</h4>
              <p>', quote1_html, '</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>')
        ```

  - block: markdown
    content:
      text: |
        ```{r grad-stats, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
        # Convert markdown formatting to HTML
        quote2_html <- gsub("\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", stats$quote2)
        
        cat('<div class="row">
          <div class="col-12">
            <div class="alert alert-success">
              <h4>Graduate Student Research</h4>
              <p>', quote2_html, '</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>')
        ```

  - block: markdown
    content:

        # Convert markdown formatting to HTML
        quote3_html <- gsub("\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", stats$quote3)
        
        cat('<div class="row">
          <div class="col-12">
            <div class="alert" style="background-color: #fff3cd; border-color: #ffeaa7; color: #856404;">
              <h4>', stats$last_year, ' Publications</h4>
